description: This file contains unit tests for the system information module in the Thunder core project. It includes tests for system architecture, firmware version, hardware info, memory, swap, uptime, CPU load, and device ID retrieval, primarily on POSIX systems, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: Thunder::Tests::Core::Purpose
classes.description: Enumeration for different purposes of system info retrieval such as memory, swap, host, chipset, and CPU load.

classes.name: Thunder::Tests::Core::Function
classes.description: Enumeration for different memory functions like total, free, available, and cached.

methods.name: PlaceValue
methods.description: Calculates 10 raised to the power of 'places'.

methods.name: Round
methods.description: Rounds a double value to a specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: GetChipset
methods.description: Extracts chipset model name from system info string.

methods.name: GetCPUJiffies
methods.description: Calculates total CPU jiffies from system info string.

methods.name: GetCPULoad
methods.description: Calculates CPU load percentage from system info string.

methods.name: GetMemoryValue
methods.description: Extracts memory value from a buffer string based on a found flag.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Retrieves specific memory info (total, free, cached, available) from system info string.

methods.name: GetSwapMemory
methods.description: Retrieves swap memory info (total, free, cached) from system info string.

methods.name: ExecuteCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and processes its output based on purpose and function.

methods.name: RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of the first active network interface.
